articles.title: Themes ETFs and Leverage Shares by Themes Closing ETFs Due to Lack of Assets
articles.summary: The Board of Trustees for the Themes ETF Trust has announced its decision to liquidate the trust, effective July 17, 2026. This move is attributed to the trust's persistent inability to attract sufficient investment assets from investors. The liquidation highlights operational challenges and a lack of market interest, leading to the winding down of the financial entity's operations after failing to meet viability thresholds.

articles.title: DC Just Gave Us a Surprising Duo I Never Knew We Needed (& It’s Shockingly Perfect)
articles.summary: DC Comics has historically centered on hero duos, a narrative staple from its early days. While superhero partnerships weren't entirely new, the introduction of characters like Robin notably evolved the established dynamic and storytelling methods in comic book narratives. This approach became a defining characteristic, shaping many iconic relationships within the DC universe.

articles.title: Kerala government clarifies on proposed shipbuilding project
articles.summary: The Kerala government has issued a formal clarification addressing widely circulated media reports regarding the Tata Group's alleged ₹10,000 crore investment in a new greenfield shipbuilding project within the state. This official statement aims to provide accurate information, potentially modifying or debunking the initial claims about this significant industrial development and its scope in Kerala.

articles.title: Canada's Wildfire Crisis Escalates: 850 Fires Burn as Smoke Blankets 100 Million Americans
articles.summary: Canada's 2026 wildfire season, after a relatively slow spring, is now intensifying rapidly across the country. Conditions have sharply deteriorated, leading to a significant surge in fires. This escalating environmental crisis highlights the growing challenges of disaster management and resource deployment, potentially impacting national readiness and emergency response efforts.

articles.title: Ultra Japan announces full 2026 line-up
articles.summary: Ultra Japan has announced the complete line-up for its 2026 music festival. Scheduled for September 19th and 20th at Tokyo's Odaiba Park, the event will feature performances from global artists including Afrojack b2b R3HAB. This major international festival draws attention to global entertainment and cultural events, highlighting Japan's role as a host for such gatherings.

articles.title: Satellite images show how Russia is winning the race for the Arctic as the US plays catch-up
articles.summary: Russia significantly upgraded its northernmost military base, Nagurskoye, in 2017, located in the Arctic. The base features a unique trefoil design, allowing personnel to access its extensive facilities entirely indoors. This innovative architecture is crucial for operational efficiency in extreme cold conditions and underscores Russia's enhanced military presence and capabilities in the strategically important Arctic region.

articles.title: India launches first hydrogen train connecting Jind to Sonipat, a 'Make in India' success
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged off India's first hydrogen-powered train, connecting Jind to Sonipat in Haryana. This landmark initiative is celebrated as a significant success for the 'Make in India' campaign, showcasing indigenous technological advancement in sustainable transportation. For an SSB aspirant, this highlights national progress in green mobility, energy independence, and self-reliance in advanced technologies, reflecting a strong push towards modern infrastructure and environmental consciousness.
